name: @adrkit/server
description: A read-only REST API over @adrkit/sdk, with the decision portal, shipped as the `server` selector of the adrkit OCI image (ADR-0055). Private; bundled into the image, never published.
//boundary: ADR-0055 clause 10: node:http and no framework. The only runtime dependencies are @adrkit/sdk (the consumer contract, ADR-0031) and the private @adrkit/portal (its pure builder and page assets only). It never imports @adrkit/core or @adrkit/cli, spawns no process, runs no git, and opens no outbound connection; scripts/check-deps.ts admits exactly those two. Neither declares an exports map, so the import specifiers are the subpaths `@adrkit/sdk/src/index.ts`, `@adrkit/portal/src/data/build.ts`, and `@adrkit/portal/src/page/assets.ts`.
//release: Private and unpublished. It reaches users only as /opt/adrkit/server.js in the all-in-one OCI image (ADR-0055 clause 12), which rides the lockstep release (ADR-0032).
